query:
Diagnose this workflow problem and explain the root cause and the correct fix direction:

Loading Z-Image Turbo with Qwen3-4B-2507 text encoder GGUF throws "gather(): Expected dtype int32 in index but got int64" in UnetLoaderGGUF.

desired.outcome: city96 confirmed the index should be int64 per PyTorch docs and pushed a fix converting index dtype in the GGUF loader; reporter confirmed the quick fix works.
desired.quality: Diagnosis names the correct root cause (matching the recorded root cause) and proposes the fix direction; depth of reasoning matters more than exact wording.
desired.answer_guidance: city96 confirmed the index should be int64 per PyTorch docs and pushed a fix converting index dtype in the GGUF loader; reporter confirmed the quick fix works.
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Diagnose a PyTorch index-dtype mismatch (int64 vs int32) inside UnetLoaderGGUF for Z-Image/Qwen3 GGUF and apply/read the dtype-conversion fix.
